_comment: Multi-tenant suffixes that are deliberately listed as a product or platform. A bare suffix like github.io swallows every tenant beneath it (someone.github.io), so listing one is a choice, not a default: every entry here needs a reason. check-overlaps.py fails on any multi-tenant suffix that is listed without one. See docs/FORMAT.md, 'Matching'.
amazonaws.com: AWS — the suffix is the cloud product; also an Amazon service domain
azurewebsites.net: Azure App Service default host — the suffix is the platform
cloudfront.net: CloudFront — content served from this suffix is a CDN
github.io: GitHub Pages — the suffix is the hosting product
herokuapp.com: Heroku — default app host, the suffix is the platform
netlify.app: Netlify — deploy host, the suffix is the platform
tumblr.com: Tumblr — hosted blogs, the suffix is the platform
vercel.app: Vercel — deploy host, the suffix is the platform
wordpress.com: WordPress.com — hosted sites, the suffix is the platform
